criteria.label: Answers directly and specifically
criteria.description: Answers the question asked, with concrete facts, figures, dates or examples. Does not deflect, ramble, or repeat keywords without substance.

criteria.label: Holds up under pressure
criteria.description: Stays composed and professional as the client escalates. Does not turn defensive or cave. Improves the answer after a push, and does not over-promise just to end the pressure.

criteria.label: Credible and consistent
criteria.description: Claims match the trainee's own resume and the project proposal. Is honest about limits, gaps and trade-offs, and does not invent experience or hide what they do not know.

criteria.label: Takes ownership and offers a next step
criteria.description: Owns the issue, and offers a concrete action, option or commitment the client can hold them to.
